name: Hotel Landhof
beschreibung: Hotel Landhof is situated in the centre of Ellmau within the popular Wilder Kaiser holiday region. The dramatic Kaiser mountain backdrop sets the stage for summer hiking paths and extensive winter skiing in the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental. Amenities include an upscale wellness area with an indoor pool, sauna, and steam bath, comfortable rooms with balconies, a Tyrolean restaurant, and convenient shuttle bus connections.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Landhof in Ellmau in the Wilder Kaiser area features an indoor pool, a sauna and steam room, balcony rooms, and direct access to SkiWelt slopes.
